title: Search for a metal tablet given to a boy by aliens

tellings.quote:
Here in Sweden, we have
been up in the north. Uh there was a guy
who said that he was a a young boy.

plain: In the north of Sweden, a man said that as a young boy he was given a metal tablet by aliens, and researchers went up there to look for it. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells this, passing on what the man told them, as one of the cases he has followed in person. If the tablet were found, it would be a physical object from an encounter.
